sections.p: A day goes on record when you open the app that day, or open it from a widget or a reminder. One a day. A day runs from 4:00 AM to 3:59 AM, so late nights count.
Missed days don't erase the ones on record.
It's between you and you. Saying Not today keeps the day on record.

Each day's work is your three rules, one task from UNSETLD and up to three of your own. Prove a task with a photo taken in the app; the photo stays on this phone. Each proven task is 10 points, up to 40 a day.

list: 600 points: 10% off one order at unsetld.com.
1,000 points: 15% off one order at unsetld.com.
Up to $25 off, one code each collection. Codes work for 30 days.
Day 7: every UNSETLD drop opens to you 24 hours before the public.
Day 90: a woven patch with your number, free with your next order.
Day 365: the 365 piece, made only for people who reach a year. It's sold at full price and never restocked.

sections.p: Once early access is open, if 14 days pass with nothing on record, it pauses until you put 7 more days on record. Your count, points and milestones stay.
One code each collection. Up to $25 off an order. Codes don't combine with other codes, including the 10% first-order code, and exclude the 365 piece. One patch per person.
Full Edition doesn't change any of this. Points and access are the same for everyone.
To use a code or access you need a free account, made with Sign in with Apple, so we can hold your place.
For US residents 13 and over. If you're under 18, get a parent's or guardian's OK before you place an order.

Access and points are earned in the app. They can't be bought, and Full Edition doesn't change them. Early access opens drops 24 hours before the public from Day 7. The patch is one per person and ships free with an order from Day 90. The 365 piece is sold at full price from Day 365.

Each task proven with a photo is 10 points, up to 40 points a day. Proof must be your own photo of that day's work, taken in the app. 600 points can be traded for 10% off one order, 1,000 points for 15%, up to $25 off. One code each collection. Codes are single use, work for 30 days and are only valid at unsetld.com. We may remove points earned through misuse.
No cash value. Not transferable. Points and codes can't be sold or exchanged for money. Codes don't combine with other codes, including the first-order code, and exclude the 365 piece.
Once early access is open, if 14 days pass with nothing on record, it pauses until 7 more days are on record. Your count, points and milestones stay.
We may change or end the program with 30 days' notice in the app. Points already earned can still be traded for 30 days after it ends.

UNSETLD gives you a daily line, daily tasks, reminders, a night check and a record of the days you showed up. It is motivation, not medical, financial or professional advice.

Full Edition is sold through Apple as an auto-renewing subscription (yearly or monthly) or a one-time lifetime purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase, or when a free trial ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in Settings, your name, Subscriptions. Any unused part of a free trial ends when you buy a subscription.
Apple's Licensed Application End User License Agreement (apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula) also applies.
Access to the clothing brand is covered by the Access terms in Settings.
The lines in the app are original to UNSETLD, except attributed quotes, which are public-domain translations. Lines you write yourself stay on your phone.
unsetldclothing@gmail.com
Your record, your standard, proof photos, saved lines and your lines live on your iPhone. There are no ads, no tracking and no analytics SDKs.

Purchases: Apple processes payments, and RevenueCat (our subscription provider) receives an anonymous app user ID and your purchase history so Full Edition works across your devices. Time check: the app asks unsetld.com for the current date so days on record stay honest. No identifier is sent. Config: the app reads a small public file from unsetld.com to know whether access is on and when drops open.
The camera is used only when you prove a task. Photos are saved inside the app on this phone and are never uploaded.

sections.h: If you sign in for codes or access
sections.p: Signing in with Apple is optional and only needed to use codes and access. We receive an Apple user ID and, if you choose, a private relay email. We store the days you put on record and the days you proved tasks (dates and counts only, never the photos) so we can hold your place and issue single-use codes. We also keep a token from Apple so we can end the Sign in with Apple link when you delete your account. Nothing else.
Reminders and the night check are local notifications scheduled on your phone. Drop alerts are separate, off by default, and only on if you turn them on.
Links to unsetld.com open in Safari, which is covered by that site's privacy policy.

Delete the app to remove what's stored on your phone. To delete an access account, open Settings in the app, then Account, then Delete account. We remove the account and what we hold for it, and end the Sign in with Apple link. You can also email unsetldclothing@gmail.com from the address on the account.
UNSETLD is for people 13 and older. We don't knowingly collect personal information from anyone under 13. If you think a child under 13 has signed in, email us and we'll delete the account.
